The '''Secured Systems''' was an area of the [[Network Access]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:NA" /> [[Eidolon Security]] maintained a [[Eidolon Security datacenter|datacenter]] in the area.<ref name="TOR:IE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Secured Systems appears as part of Network Access on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR:NA" />
